{{Quote|Gentlemen, it appears the son of Drol lives.|Jaybo Hood, to Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />}}
A '''mission to the Thicket''' took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After helping to [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|liberate]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|sentinel droid]]-turned-[[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] became based in the [[Thicket]], a patch of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] over [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] that housed the remains of a [[Mission to Iego/Legends|previously destroyed]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|laser system]]. As the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid's]] [[HELIOS-3D's droid army|amassing army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] began to cause disturbances, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] received a request for help, and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived on Iego to investigate the strange happenings.

Meeting with [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] resident [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sent a [[Republic shuttle probe droid|probe droid]] into the Thicket. However, the [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droid]] was reprogrammed by HELIOS-3D and collided with the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Torrent Four]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and sparking an [[Starfighter combat/Legends|aerial skirmish]] between Republic [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and HELIOS-3D's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces. The sentinel droid was defeated, and the Jedi searched the droid hunter's [[HELIOS-3D's Munificent-class star frigate|disabled frigate]] before departing. However, HELIOS-3D himself was able to secretly transfer his consciousness into a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Anyway, it's this patch here. Spacers call it the ''<nowiki>'</nowiki>Thicket<nowiki>.'</nowiki>'' If the Separatists have returned&mdash;''"<br />"''There's no intelligence reports to suggest that they're anywhere near this system.''"<br />"''What if someone else has moved in?|Jaybo Hood, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />}}
[[File:HELIOS-3D_HTHP3.png|thumb|left|150px|HELIOS-3D]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] formed a team of hunters to free [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]&mdash;who had been [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|previously arrested]] for crimes against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The hunters' [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|mission]] was successful, and Bane and his team escaped with Ziro.<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> Shortly thereafter, Bane transmitted the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|monetary reward]] for the mission into the accounts of his comrades and then ordered the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to flee and hide from the Republic.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part I">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]]</ref> One member of the team, the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]], became based in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] and began to form a [[HELIOS-3D's droid army|renegade army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for his own uses.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />

Named the "[[Thicket]]," the patch of space in which HELIOS-3D housed his forces was laden with [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and the remains of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]]&mdash;once thought to be the workings of Iego's mythical god, "[[Drol/Legends|Drol]]"&mdash;that had been [[Mission to Iego/Legends|destroyed]] earlier in the war by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. As HELIOS-3D caused disturbances in the space over the planet, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] received a request for help. With the elusive Cad Bane thwarting the Order's attempts to locate him, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] assigned Skywalker and Kenobi to investigate the distress call. Meeting with the young [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] resident [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]]&mdash;who had assisted them in destroying the Separatist [[Laser/Legends|laser]] field&mdash;in the Cliffhold [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were informed of the unusual activity in the Thicket and set out with Hood to find the source of the disturbances.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|This is Torrent Four. No bogeys spotted. Wait. Something at six-point five, moving fast.|Clone pilot Torrent Four, shortly before being hit by the Republic probe droid|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />}}
[[File:Destroyed_Republic_probe.png|thumb|right|230px|The probe droid is destroyed by enemy fire.]]
Approaching the asteroids of the Thicket in a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], Skywalker and Kenobi launched a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]-mounted [[Republic shuttle probe droid|probe droid]] to [[Scout/Legends|survey]] the area ahead. Learning from Hood that several automated drones sent into the Thicket earlier had stopped transmitting, Kenobi ordered [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], nicknamed "Cody," to dispatch manned vessels to monitor the [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droid]] at a closer range. A pair of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] trailed the droid, but the automated scout unexpectedly crashed into [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Torrent Four]], [[Death/Legends|eliminating]] both the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and the probe.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />

Enemy [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] advanced toward the Republic's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and engaged them in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. Another pilot was lured into the remnants of the Separatist LaserWeb Station and was killed when he flew into a laser.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" /> HELIOS-3D sent more Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] alongside [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]],<ref name="Droids Over Iego" /> and [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighters]]<ref name="TCW Incredible Vehicles" /> to fight the Republic detachment, but a single V-19 Torrent fighter was able to maneuver through the Thicket's asteroids toward the droid force. Engaging the enemy fighters, asteroid-based [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], and several active "laser rocks," the pilot defeated HELIOS-3D's forces.<ref name="Droids Over Iego" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Come on, Skywalker. This thing is just scrap. It's dead&hellip; I mean, that's the last of it&hellip; isn't it?|Jaybo Hood, on the disabled HELIOS-3D|<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />}}
Finding HELIOS-3D's [[HELIOS-3D's Munificent-class star frigate|disabled ''Munificent''-class frigate]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody was able to reactivate the [[Frigate/Legends|vessel's]] life support through generators. Skywalker, Kenobi, and Hood boarded the ship and discovered a disabled HELIOS-3D, and Skywalker salvaged the sentinel droid's cranial unit for further study before departing the frigate in the [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]. Unbeknownst to the Republic, however, HELIOS-3D had transferred his consciousness into a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] elsewhere amongst the asteroids.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to the Thicket was the subject of the [[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''Hunting the Hunters (Part III)'']], an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' online comic series]] that transitioned between the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first]] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second seasons]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Hunting the Hunters Part III" />
